whoosh.use: Medium whoosh, L→R. Transitions, whips, fast moves.

swish.use: Short bright swish. Text/graphic swoosh-ins, quick whips.

whoosh_long.use: Long, dark whoosh. Chapter transitions, slow pushes.

riser.use: 1.6s build. Into drops, reveals, hype cuts; end it on the hit.

boom.use: Deep sub hit with tail. Reveals, crash zooms, big punchlines.

slam.use: Punchy impact. Title word slams, plate drops, smash cuts.

thud.use: Soft low thud. Stamps, landings, small impacts.

ding.use: Bright bell. Counter landings, correct answers, PRs.

marker.use: Felt-marker scribble. Arrows and circles drawing on.

record_scratch.use: Vinyl scratch. Freeze-frames, 'wait what' moments, music stops.

boing.use: Cartoon boing. Fails, bounces, silly moments.
